facts.fact: Judicalex says it has digitised the hearing roll, now online, and all decisions of the Conakry commercial court since its creation, including judgments and orders.

systems.owner: Judicalex (company, partner of Tribunal de commerce de Conakry)

facts.fact: Guinea's UCEP published the award on 5 October 2026 of a 12-month, USD 26,400 consultancy, signed 7 September 2026, to set up, manage and optimise the Tribunal de Commerce de Conakry's integrated management, archiving and digital communication system, with its website, case-law database and IT estate.
facts.system: système intégré de gestion, d'archivage et de communication numérique du Tribunal de Commerce de Conakry

systems.system: système intégré de gestion, d'archivage et de communication numérique du TCC

note: The document says nothing about courts.
OGDH says several court registries are not digitised, which does not say all are on paper or that any system exists.

systems.owner: Central Criminal Records Directorate, Ministry of Justice

note: Document concerns digitising criminal record data, not a court case management system.
